page.content:
The Control Room Technician was a scientist for SPECTRE, who was killed by James Bond. The character appears as a supporting antagonist in the 1967 James Bond film You Only Live Twice. He is portrayed by Anthony Chinn.

page.overview:
Who is Control Room Technician?

The Control Room Technician was a scientist for SPECTRE, who was killed by James Bond. The character appears as a supporting antagonist in the 1967 James Bond film You Only Live Twice. He is portrayed by Anthony Chinn.
